title: Whole Genome Sequencing Protocol using Illumina NextSeq 1000 Platform
author: Ma. Carmel Javier
materials: REAGENTS NEEDED: ● EBLTS HT (Enrichment BLT HT) ● TB1 HT (Tagmentation Buffer 1 HT) ● Nuclease-free water About the Reagents Store EBLTS HT upright at temperatures above2°C. Make sure beads are always submerged in the buffer. If beads are adhered to the side or top of the96-well plate, centrifuge at 500 × g for 1 minute, and then pipette toresuspend.
CONSUMABLES AND REAGENTS ● EPM HT (Enhanced PCR Mix HT) ● Index adapters (IDT for Illumina-PCR Indexes Set 1, 2, 3, 4) ● Nuclease-free water ● 15 ml tubes ● 96 well PCR Plates
CONSUMABLES AND REAGENTS ● ITB (Illumina Tune Beads) ● RSB HT (Resuspension Buffer HT) ● Freshly prepared 80% ethanol (EtOH) ● 1.5 ml tube (2 per 96-well sample plate) ● PCR 8-tube strip

steps.title: Prepare Tagmentation Reaction
steps.instruction: Prepare the tagmentation reaction in a labeled 96-well PCR plate (TAG1).

substeps.instruction: Label a new 96-well PCR plate as TAG1, Run #, and Date.
Prepare Tagmentation Master Mix (multiply volumes by number of samples) and add 30 μl to each well of the TAG1 plate using reverse pipetting with a single-channel pipette.
Add 20 μl of PCR product to each corresponding well in the TAG1 plate.
Seal and shake the plate at 1600 rpm for 1 minute.
Centrifuge at 1000 x g for 1 minute if contents are sticking to walls or seal.

steps.title: Run Tagmentation Program
steps.instruction: Process the TAG1 plate on a thermal cycler.

substeps.instruction: Set the preheat lid option to 55°C for 5 minutes.
Hold at 10°C.
Set the reaction volume to 50 μl.

steps.title: Stop Tagmentation and Wash Beads
steps.instruction: Stop the tagmentation reaction and perform bead cleanup.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the TAG1 plate at 500 x g for 1 minute.
Dispense 10 μl of ST2 HT (Stop Tagment Buffer 2 HT) to each well of a PCR 8-strip tube (multiply by samples per row, adding 5 μl extra per tube for pipetting error).
Carefully remove the seal of the TAG1 plate and immediately add 10 μl of ST2 HT from the 8-strip tube to each well.
Seal the plate and shake at 1600 rpm for 1 minute.
Incubate the plate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge at 500 x g for 1 minute.

Remove the seal and place the plate on a magnetic stand for 3 minutes (or until liquid is clear). If bubbles are present on the seal, centrifuge at 500 x g for 1 minute and return to the magnetic stand for ~3 minutes.
Remove and discard all supernatants using a reservoir for waste.
Remove the plate from the magnetic stand and add 100 μl of TWB HT (Tagmentation Wash Buffer HT) to each well.
Seal and shake at 1600 rpm for 1 minute, then centrifuge at 500 x g for 1 minute.
Place the plate on the magnetic stand for 3 minutes (or until liquid is clear).
For the first wash only, remove and discard all supernatants. Repeat the wash process.
After the second wash, do not remove the plate from the magnetic stand and do not discard the supernatant to prevent over-drying.

steps.title: Perform Library Amplification
steps.instruction: Amplify the tagmented DNA using PCR Master Mix and index adapters.

substeps.instruction: Remove supernatant (TWB HT) from the TAG1 plate. To avoid over-drying, remove supernatant from the first 2 columns first, using a 10 μl or 20 μl pipette for remaining liquid.
Move columns away from the magnetic stand and add 40 μl of PCR Master Mix directly to the beads in each well.
Add 10 μl of index adapters to each well (one index per sample well) and record the index used.
Seal and shake the plate at 1600 rpm for 1 minute, then centrifuge at 500 x g for 1 minute.
Ensure beads are fully re-suspended; if not, use a pipette set to 35 μl with the plunger down to slowly mix.

Run the following PCR program with the preheat lid set to 100°C and reaction volume set to 50 μl: 72°C for 3 min; 98°C for 3 min; 7 cycles of (98°C for 20 sec, 60°C for 30 sec, 72°C for 1 min); 72°C for 3 min; Hold at 10°C.

steps.title: Pool and Clean Up Libraries
steps.instruction: Pool the libraries and perform a cleanup using ITB (Illumina Tube Beads).

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the TAG1 plate at 500 x g for 1 minute.
Remove the seal, place on a magnetic stand for 3 minutes (or until clear), and transfer 5 μl of library from each well to a PCR 8-tube strip (total 60 μl per row), changing tips after each column.
Transfer 55 μl of the pooled library from each 8-tube strip well into a 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube (ITB tube). Total volume for 96 samples is 440 μl.
Vortex the Pooled ITB tubes and spin down.
Vortex ITB to resuspend and add ITB volume equal to 0.9x the Pooled ITB tube volume (e.g., for 96 samples: 440 μl x 0.9 = 396 μl; for NTC: 20 μl x 0.9 = 18 μl).
Vortex to mix, incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes, and centrifuge briefly.
Place on a magnetic stand for 5 minutes until clear, then discard all supernatants.
Keep the tube on the magnetic stand and add 1000 μl of freshly prepared 80% ethanol (ensure beads are submerged). Wait 30 seconds, then discard supernatant.
Repeat the ethanol wash a second time, use a 20 μl pipette to remove all residual ethanol, and air-dry beads for at least 2 minutes (do not over-dry).
Remove the tube from the rack, add 55 μl of RSB HT (Re-suspension Buffer), vortex, and centrifuge briefly.
Incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes, then place on the magnetic stand for 2 minutes until clear.
Transfer 50 μl of the supernatant to a new low-bind microcentrifuge tube, leaving at least 2 μl to avoid beads.
Repeat the ITB cleanup steps (f through t) using a 1:1 ITB and sample ratio for a second cleanup.

steps.title: Quantify and Dilute Libraries
steps.instruction: Analyze library concentration and size to determine final loading dilution.

substeps.instruction: Analyze 2 μl of library pool, NTC, and PC using a Qubit dsDNA HS Assay kit. If outside the standard range, dilute 1:10 and re-analyze.
Estimate library size using an Agilent Bioanalyzer (average size ~300 bp).
Calculate molarity and dilute 5 μl of the library to 4 nM.
Perform a second Qubit reading on 2 μl of the 4 nM library pool to obtain exact concentration (dilute 1:10 if necessary).
Dilute the library to 2 nM, and then to the final loading concentration of 1 nM/1000 pM.

steps.title: Load NextSeq 1000
steps.instruction: Load the final diluted library onto the platform.

substeps.instruction: Load 20 μl of the diluted library with a final concentration of 1000 pM.
Start the run.
